scope: Bounded primary-source inventory for local CBCT research. TF2 acquired and preparing; labelled STS 3D acquired and audited; no trained model or exhaustive coverage claim.
evidence_policy: Counts are QUOTED from cited sources unless explicitly marked otherwise. Listing a licence is not a legal permission determination. Source files, labels, access, terms, checksums and patient grouping must be checked at ingestion.

datasets.name: ToothFairy
datasets.labels: Inferior alveolar canal; sparse annotations differ from dense voxel labels.
datasets.access: Registration required at Ditto; files advertised, not downloaded.
datasets.licence: Not verified from accessed primary pages.
datasets.route: Optional canal-specific task; use sparse-label-aware loss. Prefer newer labels for duplicate cases.
blockers: Verify licence and downloaded metadata.
Overlaps ToothFairy2/3; do not count as independent patients.
Official private challenge test is not released.

datasets.name: ToothFairy2
datasets.labels: Jaws, bilateral inferior alveolar canals and maxillary sinuses, pharynx, bridges/crowns/implants, FDI teeth. Exact IDs come from dataset.json; placeholder NA IDs are not anatomy.
datasets.format: Downloaded release: MHA. Metadata uses Background/channels_names aliases; local converter normalizes them and retains source IDs.
datasets.access: Official archive acquired through the signed-in account; moved into isolated data folder.
datasets.licence: CC BY-SA; benchmark dataset.json specifies CC-BY-SA 4.0.
datasets.route: Primary multi-structure baseline or compatibility mapping from TF3.
blockers: Data preparation and downstream training/evaluation are ongoing.
P/F identities overlap other ToothFairy releases; never split the same source identity across cohorts.
Source CRC, geometry, labels and checksums are checked case by case.

datasets.name: ToothFairy3
datasets.labels: TF2 structures plus tooth-specific pulp cavities, bilateral incisive canals and lingual canal.
datasets.format: NIfTI; source explicitly warns of RPI orientation.
datasets.access: Ditto registration required; private challenge test unavailable.
datasets.licence: CC-BY-NC-SA stated by official challenge dataset page; exact version not verified.
datasets.route: Preferred broad research segmentation source if terms fit intended use.
blockers: All P/F cases overlap TF2; do not concatenate releases as new patients.
Do not assume TF2 licence applies.
Pin authoritative dataset.json; older repository descriptions disagree with current class count.
Orientation/affine and label mapping required.

datasets.name: ToothFairy4
datasets.modality: CBCT plus Italian and English reports
datasets.labels: Clinical reports; no new segmentation-label package established.
datasets.licence: Not verified from accessed primary page.
datasets.route: Separate future report-generation task; not automatic extra segmentation supervision.
blockers: P/F/S reuse TF3 and may differ in orientation.
Source counts conflict: CALCULATED table total 417+63+52+100=632, versus headline 625. Reconcile manifest before reporting unique count.
English reports use LLM translation; do not treat as independent clinician annotations.
Licence unresolved.

datasets.name: Pulpy3D
datasets.labels: Semantic/instance pulp annotations and reused inferior alveolar nerve annotations; page's class-description wording refers to lower teeth/anomaly teeth, so exact target meaning needs dataset.json.
datasets.licence: Not verified from accessed primary page.
datasets.route: Pulp/canal-specific task only after overlap and ontology reconciliation.
blockers: Extends ToothFairy; overlapping cases cannot span train/test.
Potential duplication of newer TF3 pulp labels.
Verify label definitions and licence.

datasets.name: CTooth / CTooth+
datasets.labels: Tooth-volume masks; exact instance/semantic schema depends on release.
datasets.access: Official repository redirects users to STS challenge; older institutional-email request route remains documented. No request sent.
datasets.licence: Conflicting primary statements: README CC BY 4.0; requisition text restricts modification, redistribution and commercial use and says research only.
datasets.route: Treat as provenance ancestor of STS, not additional independent volume count.
blockers: Resolve release-specific terms rather than assuming README licence supersedes requisition conditions.
Direct current standalone data access not established.
Deduplicate against STS releases.

datasets.name: STS-Tooth / STS-3D-Tooth
datasets.labels: Dental-region segmentation plus unlabelled CBCT; do not infer numbered-tooth classes.
datasets.format: NIfTI; paired image/mask grids match in the acquired labelled cases. Measured header spacings differ between Integrity and ROI.
datasets.access: Labelled 3D Integrity/ROI archive members downloaded with CRC verification; local header/label audit completed.
datasets.route: Keep separate. Add only after label ontology, physical calibration and cross-crop patient grouping are resolved.
blockers: Integrity masks are binary, while ROI masks contain IDs 1, 2 and sometimes 4; no authoritative meaning for every ROI ID has been established.
Integrity headers use 1 mm isotropic spacing; source calibration must be verified before physical measurements or joint resampling.
ROI/full-volume patient correspondence is not established.
Unlabelled and 2D files were not acquired: no compatible training objective is implemented.

datasets.name: STS 2024, 3D CBCT track
datasets.labels: Permanent-tooth instance segmentation/identification; verify FDI ID map from files.
datasets.format: Inspected Zenodo payload: 2D JPG/JSON; advertised 3D payload not present in that record.
datasets.access: The linked Zenodo archive was downloaded and checksum verified. It contains JPG images plus JSON annotations, not CBCT NIfTI volumes.
datasets.licence: Zenodo record 17712688: CC BY 4.0. Applicable 3D release terms still need checking.
datasets.route: Candidate external tooth-specific training/evaluation cohort, subject to exact annotations.
blockers: Do not treat the inspected 2D payload as 3D training data.
The repository alternative 3D links and their exact release need inspection.
Potential CTooth/STS family overlap remains.

datasets.name: DentVoxel
datasets.labels: Maxilla, mandible, bilateral sinuses and mandibular canals, FDI individual teeth.
datasets.access: BLOCKED: current version 3 API has is_metadata_record=true and no files despite description advertising public data.
datasets.route: Potential independent multi-structure cohort once actual source files exist and provenance is checked.
blockers: No downloadable payload in inspected current record.
Do not assume independent patients without provenance.
Label boundary definitions differ from TF2/3 and require mapping.

datasets.name: 3D multimodal dental dataset based on CBCT and oral scan
datasets.modality: Paired CBCT and intraoral surface scan
datasets.labels: Corresponding dense CBCT segmentation masks not established by inspected landing page.
datasets.format: Volume .gz files paired with STL/PLY surfaces. No filename indicates a separate voxel segmentation mask.
datasets.access: Figshare metadata and complete central directories of all listed archives inspected by bounded range reads; no image payload acquired.
datasets.route: Registration or unlabelled CBCT pretraining; supervised segmentation only if valid labels are found.
blockers: Archive manifests do not establish dense voxel reference masks.
Surface scans cannot be silently substituted for internal volumetric labels.
A separate unlabelled pretraining/registration objective would be needed.

datasets.name: PhysioNet multimodal dental dataset v1.1.0
datasets.modality: CBCT DICOM, panoramic and CBCT-derived periapical images
datasets.labels: Tooth localisation described; release includes implant-presence labels. Dense voxel masks not established.
datasets.access: Credentialing, CITI training, signed DUA and project review by contributor required.
datasets.licence: PhysioNet Contributor Review Health Data License 1.5.0.
datasets.route: Optional unlabelled/localisation research after access approval; not ready segmentation supervision.
blockers: Do not download legacy v1.0.0: v1.1.0 removes cases without informed consent.
Group repeat visits and derived modalities by original patient.
Restricted data access must not be shared; no request submitted.
Local storage/security conditions must comply with approved access.

model_resources.name: ToothSeg
model_resources.kind: Public code and pretrained weights, not a new public training dataset.
model_resources.training_provenance: Public checkpoints trained on ToothFairy2. Paper states in-house 1,282-case data cannot be made public and must be requested.
model_resources.licence: Code Apache-2.0; Zenodo checkpoint metadata cc-by-4.0.
model_resources.route: Baseline inference or initialization only; do not evaluate on TF2 as unseen training-independent data.

model_resources.name: DentalSegmentator
model_resources.kind: Pretrained model, not an established open source training-scan archive.
model_resources.labels: Upper skull, mandible, upper teeth, lower teeth, mandibular canal.
model_resources.route: Coarse anatomy baseline; does not provide individual FDI teeth or full TF2 ontology.

ingestion_gates: Record exact downloaded version, source, licence and attribution.
Verify image-label alignment, voxel units, affine handedness/orientation and valid label IDs.
Deduplicate patient/scan families across releases before any split.
Keep all visits, crops, meshes, reports and translations of a patient in one split.
Reserve independent evaluation patients; do not train on every accessible case.
Treat unannotated structures as unknown, never silently background.
Use task-specific label maps; do not merge same integer IDs from different ontologies.
Record source-specific performance, not just aggregate metrics.
No clinical accuracy claim without appropriate expert reference evaluation.
